deviations: Scheduling adaptation: rejection executes bounded owner-requested work batches and yields IN_PROGRESS, retaining shared state and fresh bounds on the next poll. No total retry limit, implicit reseed or bound repair is added; unreachable ranges remain pending until owner cancellation/reset or a range change.

Safety correction: reject invalid stored counts/indices outside the bounded 2048-WORD table before access, preserving earlier completed state effects. No saturation, overshoot clamp, counter-wrap rejection or implicit loop termination is introduced.

Portable timing policy: translate nominal 18.2 wait units/second directly to local monotonic nanoseconds, rounding deadlines up. Numeric byte timeout is the first integral ns beyond73 nominal units (4010989011ns); each acquisition rearms after its effects. No BIOS tick phase, midnight state or IRQ/foreign clock domain is reproduced. Saturate deadline addition and reject backwards local samples.
